Vendored LG webOS TV SDK
========================

Upstream: https://webostv.developer.lge.com/assets/library/webOSTVjs-1.2.13.zip
Version:  webOSTVjs 1.2.13 (LG official release; full support for webOS TV 4.0+,
          the Chromium 53 floor of this client)
SHA-256:  507c759f65a035122afead166608e8c7f444961468c3570245f0982c8f855ff6

Extracted verbatim from that zip (no modifications):
  webOSTVjs-1.2.13/webOSTV.js       window.webOS (deviceInfo, keyboard, service, ...)
  webOSTVjs-1.2.13/webOSTV-dev.js   window.webOSDev (connection.getStatus, launch, ...)
  webOSTVjs-1.2.13/LICENSE-2.0.txt  supplied Apache License 2.0

The zip is pinned by the URL and SHA-256 above; re-download it to verify these
copies. The application loads the vendored files from its own package (never
fetches code from the network on the TV). Both scripts are transpiled ES5 and
parse under the Chromium 53 target (verified by the webOS engine smoke run).
